title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Listening Test 1 Part 1
description: Đoạn hội thoại giao tiếp thường ngày chuẩn đề thi Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 1 Part 1.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (1)
lines.text: IELTS 20.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (2)
lines.text: Published by Cambridge University Press and Assessment twenty twenty five.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (3)
lines.text: This recording is copyright.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (4)
lines.text: Test one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (5)
lines.text: This is the IELTS listening test.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (6)
lines.text: You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (7)
lines.text: There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (8)
lines.text: All the recordings will be played once only.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (9)
lines.text: The test is in four parts.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (10)
lines.text: At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (11)
lines.text: Now turn to part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (12)
lines.text: Part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (13)
lines.text: You will hear a woman asking a friend for restaurant recommendations.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (14)
lines.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (15)
lines.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (16)
lines.text: I've been meaning to ask you for some advice about restaurants.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (17)
lines.text: I need to book somewhere to celebrate my sister's thirtieth birthday, and I liked the sound of that place you went to for your mom's fiftieth.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (18)
lines.text: The junction.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (19)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (20)
lines.text: I'd definitely recommend that for a special occasion.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (21)
lines.text: We had a great time there.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (22)
lines.text: Everyone really enjoyed it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (23)
lines.text: Where is it again?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (24)
lines.text: I can't remember.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (25)
lines.text: It's on Grayson Street, only about a two minute walk from the station.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (26)
lines.text: Oh, that's good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (27)
lines.text: I'd prefer not to have to drive anywhere.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (28)
lines.text: But I don't want to have to walk too far either.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (29)
lines.text: Yes, the location's perfect, but that's not necessarily why I'd recommend it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (30)
lines.text: The food's amazing.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (31)
lines.text: If you like fish, it's probably the best restaurant in town for that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (32)
lines.text: It's always really fresh and there are lots of interesting dishes to choose from.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (33)
lines.text: But all the food is good there.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (34)
lines.text: Is it really expensive?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (35)
lines.text: It's certainly not cheap, but for a special occasion, I think it's fine.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (36)
lines.text: It's got a great atmosphere and before dinner, you can go up on the roof and have a drink.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (37)
lines.text: It's really nice up there, but you need to book.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (38)
lines.text: It's very popular as the views are spectacular.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (39)
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (40)
lines.text: So that's definitely a possibility then.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (41)
lines.text: Is there anywhere else you can think of?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (42)
lines.text: Um, if you want somewhere a bit less formal, then you could try Paloma.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (43)
lines.text: Where's that?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (44)
lines.text: I haven't heard of it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (45)
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (46)
lines.text: It's quite new.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (47)
lines.text: It's only been open a few months, but it's got a great reputation already.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (48)
lines.text: It's in a really beautiful old building on Bow Street.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (49)
lines.text: Oh, I think I know where you mean.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (50)
lines.text: Right beside the cinema.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (51)
lines.text: Yes, that's it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (52)
lines.text: I've only been there a couple of times, but I was really impressed.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (53)
lines.text: The chef used to work at Don Felipe's apparently.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (54)
lines.text: I was really sorry when that closed down.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (55)
lines.text: So is all the food they serve Spanish then?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (56)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (57)
lines.text: You can get lots of small dishes to share, which always works really well if you're in a group.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (58)
lines.text: Worth thinking about.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (59)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (60)
lines.text: There's a lively atmosphere and the waiters are really friendly.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (61)
lines.text: The only thing is that you need to pay a u00a350 deposit to book a table.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (62)
lines.text: A lot of restaurants are doing that these days.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (63)
lines.text: I should have a look at the menu to check there's a good choice of vegetarian dishes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (64)
lines.text: A couple of my friends have stopped eating meat.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (65)
lines.text: Not sure.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (66)
lines.text: I'd say the selection of those would be quite limited.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (67)
lines.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (68)
lines.text: Now listen and answer questions five to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (69)
lines.text: I've just thought of another idea.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (70)
lines.text: Have you been to the Audley?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (71)
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (72)
lines.text: Don't think I've heard of it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (73)
lines.text: How's it spelled?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (74)
lines.text: A u d l e y.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (75)
lines.text: You must have heard of it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (76)
lines.text: There's been a lot about it in the press.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (77)
lines.text: I don't tend to pay much attention to that kind of thing.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (78)
lines.text: So where is it exactly?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (79)
lines.text: It's in that hotel near Baxter Bridge on the Top Floor.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (80)
lines.text: Oh, the views would be incredible from up there.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (81)
lines.text: Yeah, I'd love to go.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (82)
lines.text: I can't think of the chef's name, but she was a judge on that TV cookery show recently.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (83)
lines.text: And she's written a couple of cookery books.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (84)
lines.text: Oh, Angela Frain.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (85)
lines.text: That's the one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (86)
lines.text: Anyway, it's had excellent reviews from all the newspapers.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (87)
lines.text: That would be a memorable place for a celebration.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (88)
lines.text: Definitely.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (89)
lines.text: Obviously, it's worth going there just for the view, but the food is supposed to be really special.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (90)
lines.text: She only likes cooking with local products, doesn't she?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (91)
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (92)
lines.text: Everything at the restaurant has to be sourced within a short distance and absolutely nothing flown in from abroad.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (93)
lines.text: I imagine it's really expensive, though.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (94)
lines.text: Well, you could go for the set lunch.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (95)
lines.text: That's quite reasonable for a top class restaurant.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (96)
lines.text: u00a330 ahead.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (97)
lines.text: In evening, I think it'd be more like u00a350.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (98)
lines.text: At least that, I should think.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (99)
lines.text: But I'm sure everyone would enjoy it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (100)
lines.text: It's not the kind of place you leave feeling hungry though, is it?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (101)
lines.text: With tiny portions?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (102)
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (103)
lines.text: The reviews I've read didn't mention that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (104)
lines.text: I imagine they'd be average.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (105)
lines.text: Well, that's all great.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (106)
lines.text: That is the end of part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (107)
lines.text: You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
